 AFP Gianluca Minchiotti Oct 23, 2026 08:27-07:00 Translated by Cristiano Ronaldo wins and scores: he is up to 982 goals in official matches
 C. Ronaldo Al Nassr FC Saudi Pro League Al-Faisaly vs Al Nassr FC Al-Faisaly The Portuguese star continues his climb towards 1,000 career goals in official matches.
 Cristiano Ronaldo scored in Al Nassr's 3-1 away win at Al Faysaly to reach 982 career goals. The 41-year-old Portuguese star has taken another step towards 1,000 goals in official matches. Today's strike takes CR7 to 836 club goals (in 1,109 appearances) and 146 for the national team (in 234 matches). 
 Across his clubs, Ronaldo's goals break down as follows : 5 for Sporting Lisbon, 145 for Manchester United, 450 for Real Madrid, 101 for Juventus and 134 for Al Nassr. 
 This season, Ronaldo has scored 6 goals for Al Nassr , 5 in the Saudi Pro League and 1 in the Asian Champions League. Today, the five-time Ballon d'Or winner put his side 2-0 up from a Joao Felix assist. Al Hamdan and Angelo scored Al Nassr's other two goals. Bongonda scored for Al Faysaly.
